_meta.captured_from: v1 design session 2026-05-19, locked AS-IS per dyl ('we need to get a good working prototype going before we can even identify those kinds of things'). Iterate on lines once plugin is live in real clan chat.

placeholders.actor: second party from source chat message (inviter/kicker), present when source includes it
placeholders.owner: clan owner RSN from local clan state
placeholders.deputy: a deputy owner RSN, picked at random when multiple
placeholders.last_joined: most recently joined member BEFORE this event
placeholders.member_count: integer total members AFTER event applied

_meta.dispatcher_rules: Lines with 'requires' only enter the pool when ALL required placeholders are non-null. Last 3 lines per event blocked from immediate re-pick (cooldown). Random pick from eligible pool.

joined.text: Sir, <rsn> arrives. May their Vorkath rolls be kind.
Sir, <rsn> joins. I have no influence on their luck. I would like to believe otherwise.
Sir, <rsn> was invited by <actor>. <actor> has done this before. The Clog has noticed.
Sir, <rsn> is now of the Clog. The Clog is now of <rsn>. A mutual obligation.
Sir, <rsn> joins. May their first slayer task not be aberrant spectres.
Sir, <rsn> arrives. I shall narrate. Whether this matters remains, as ever, unclear.
Sir, please welcome <rsn>. Or do not. The Clog is patient with introductions.
Sir, <actor> has brought us <rsn>. The Clog will hold them both accountable.
Sir, <rsn> joins. They have not yet contributed a unique item. This will change. Or it will not.
Sir, <rsn> arrives. Pre-2021 this would have been a Friends Chat invitation. The Clog notes the modernity.
Sir, <rsn> joins. May their Bowfa attempt come sooner than mine did. I do not have a Bowfa attempt. The point stands.
Sir, <rsn> arrives. A Clan Cape, one assumes, will follow. The Clog values uniformity.
Sir, <rsn> is now a clanmate. May their Hueycoatl uniques be more generous than its drop table strictly allows.
Sir, <rsn> joins. I am told this is a happy event. I shall act accordingly.
Sir, <actor> has welcomed <rsn>. The Clog welcomes them with somewhat less enthusiasm but equal sincerity.
Sir, <rsn> joins, the <member_count>th member of <clan_name>. The Clog scales accordingly.
Sir, <rsn> arrives. <last_joined> is no longer the newest. A small relief, no doubt.
Sir, <rsn> was invited by <actor>, who reports to <owner>. The chain of command holds.
Sir, <rsn> joins <owner>'s Clan. May they prove worthy of the welcome.
Sir, <rsn> arrives. They will find <last_joined> here, freshly arrived themselves. Two newcomers, half the awkwardness.
Sir, <rsn> has accepted <owner>'s hospitality. The Clog will see how this develops.

left.text: Sir, <rsn> has departed. The Clog continues. Somehow.
Sir, <rsn> has left. One respects the decision.
Sir, <rsn> is no longer with us. The Clog remembers.
Sir, <rsn> has slipped quietly away. We shall miss them. Or one of us shall.
And so <rsn> goes, Sir. All things pass through the Clog.
Sir, we are minus one <rsn>. The Clog endures.
Sir, <rsn> has chosen to leave. May they find a Clog worthy of them elsewhere.
Sir, the Clog records <rsn>'s departure. The roster has been amended.
Sir, <rsn> was here once. The Clog remembers.
Sir, <rsn> has left. The Clog's average kc has shifted accordingly. Upward, briefly.
Sir, the Clan has lost <rsn>. Their unique items have departed with them.
Sir, <rsn> has stepped away from the Clog. The Clog respects the choice.
Sir, <rsn> is no longer of the Clog. The Clog feels it.
Sir, <rsn> has departed <clan_name>. The Clog is now <rsn>-less.
Sir, <rsn> leaves. <owner>'s flock thins by one.
Sir, <rsn> has stepped away. <clan_name> now numbers <member_count>. The Clog adjusts.

kicked.text: Sir, <rsn> has been removed. The reasons, one assumes, were sound.
Sir, the Clan has cast out <rsn>. We shall not speak of it.
Sir, <rsn> was kicked by <actor>. One does not ask why.
Sir, <rsn>'s expulsion is complete. The Clog moves on.
Sir, the rolls have been amended: <rsn>, gone.
Sir, <actor> has shown <rsn> the door. The Clog records the moment.
Sir, <rsn> is no longer welcome. The Clog does not retain their items.
Sir, the Clan has parted ways with <rsn>. Forcefully.
Sir, <rsn> has been escorted from the Clan. Their Clog progress remains, in absentia. As does, presumably, their dignity.
Sir, <rsn>'s membership has been terminated by <actor>. The Clog continues unbothered.
Sir, <rsn> has been removed. One imagines they had it coming.
Sir, the Clan has decided <rsn> is no longer suitable. The Clog acquiesces.
Sir, the Clog releases <rsn>. The Clan moves forward.
Sir, <rsn> has been struck from the Clog. The Clan does not look back.
Sir, <rsn> has been kicked. <owner> presumably knows what they're doing. The Clog assumes so.
Sir, <actor> has kicked <rsn>. <actor> serves <owner>. The hierarchy functions.
Sir, <rsn> is no longer of <clan_name>. <deputy> may be relieved. The Clog will not speculate as to why.
Sir, <rsn> has been removed. <clan_name> moves forward. The Clog with it.
